verdict.rationale: Resend supports multiple verified domains with their own DKIM/reputation and API keys scoped to a single domain (resend-docs-5, resend-docs-8, resend-docs-25), giving some tenant separation, but there is no documented concept of subaccounts/subusers, and suppression lists (resend-docs-7) appear to be account-wide rather than per-domain/tenant. Missing for 10: subaccount/subuser primitives, per-tenant suppression list isolation, explicit reputation isolation guarantees across tenants, and any independent verification of multi-tenant isolation at scale.
